content:
maria: onboarding helios-13b v1.2 - seeing weird metric delta between float and q4f runs. quant-run shows +4% rouge drop, but raw logits look aligned. could be tokenizer mapping change in the latest checkpoint?

devon: CI reported a mismatch in token ids when running the eval harness, saw a bunch of off-by-one sentinel ids. attaching quick example from local: 

sam: ```
# REPL snippet (float vs quant tokenizer)
>>> tokenizer_float.encode("Hello <s> world")
[74, 198, 456, 2]
>>> tokenizer_quant.encode("Hello <s> world")
[74, 199, 456, 2]
```

devon: and the model's token_map.json differs between checkpoints: 

sam: ```diff
-  "<s>": 198
+  "<s>": 199
```

ci-bot: eval-runner job 342 failed: metric_regression > threshold (rouge: +4.2%). See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/342

alex: if the tokenizer mapping moved, the eval runner's collate path should normalize token ids against model/token_map before computing prefix lengths / KV cache offsets. right now we assume ids are stable which is fragile.

maria: agreed. quick mitigation: remap special tokens at collate time based on model artifact. patch idea: 

sam: ```python
# collate normalization (pseudo)
def normalize_tokens(token_ids, token_map):
    # token_map: strings->ids coming from model artifact
    remap = {v:int(k) if isinstance(k,int) else v for k,v in token_map.items()}
    return [remap.get(t, t) for t in token_ids]
```

alex: also add a CI gate that compares token_map hash between the model artifact and the tokenizer package used in the runner; fail onboarding with a clear error if they diverge. that will catch silent shifts.

maria: sounds good — i'll open a small PR against eval-runner: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/987 (draft). cc @devon @sam for review.

devon: can we also add a lightweight unit test that encodes a set of sentinel prompts and verifies id parity before running heavy evals? cheap and saves compute.

maria: yes. will add test + CI token_map check. planning to land the normalization patch first then follow up with CI gate.

sam: one more note: double-check quant conversion step in the quantizer pipeline — we've seen tokenizer exports get regenerated during quant compile in other models. might be a pipeline bug, not model team.

alex: good call. if pipeline rewritten token_map we need a root-cause ticket. can someone open an ops issue if we still see churn after this fix?

maria: will monitor the next dedicated onboarding run. thanks all :raised_hands:
